description: Query available time slots for a provider and service within a date range.

provider_id.description: ID of the service provider to query

service_id.description: ID of the service to query availability for

date_from.description: ISO 8601 start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the query range

date_to.description: ISO 8601 end date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the query range

slot_duration_minutes.description: Requested slot duration in minutes; must be positive and compatible with service duration
